create_BaseMediaWriter: create a BaseMediaWriter instance with output folder, filename template, and max file size
run_BaseMediaWriter: run the BaseMediaWriter pipeline to write media documents from a DocumentsPipeline to disk
write_media_document: write a single Media object to disk using the BaseMediaWriter write method with rank and kwargs
get_output_filename: get the output filename for a Media object by substituting rank and metadata tags in the filename template
switch_large_files: split large output files by max size using automatic file switching and sequential file id prefixes
